link.4ba247503225.source: This course uses the Chat Completions API throughout: you keep the conversation as a messages[] array in your own code and resend the full array on every turn. The newer Responses API can hold the thread server-side instead, so you send only the new input and a reference to the prior turn. Either way the model stays stateless and unchanged between calls. The conversation lives outside it, in state your code or the server keeps.
link.4ba247503225.value: 本课程始终使用 Chat Completions API：您需要在自己的代码中以 messages[] 数组保存对话，并在每一轮重新发送完整数组。较新的 Responses API 则可以在服务器端保存对话线程，因此您只需发送新输入以及对上一轮的引用。无论采用哪种方式，模型在各次调用之间都保持无状态且不会发生改变。对话存在于模型之外，由代码或服务器维护相应状态。

link.5537840cabb5.source: Classic agent designs differ at the decision step. Russell and Norvig's Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach arranges them as a spectrum, from a bare reflex agent up to a learning agent that improves its own rules. This course starts with rigid logic, then adds a language model and engineered context to move toward a model-based, goal-oriented loop. Later modules keep that loop running over changing state, which is the pattern learning agents build on.
link.5537840cabb5.value: 经典智能体设计的区别在于决策步骤。Russell 和 Norvig 的 Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach 将这些设计排列成一条谱系：从仅具备反射机制的智能体，到能够改进自身规则的学习型智能体。本课程先从固定逻辑入手，再加入语言模型和经过设计的上下文，逐步构建基于模型、以目标为导向的循环。后续模块会让这一循环在不断变化的状态下持续运行，这正是学习型智能体赖以发展的模式。

rich.26fa1b3522c4.source: The reasoning step is replaceable. Perception and action do not care which decision function sits between them. A simple rule, a decision tree, a search routine, or a neural network can drive the same loop. Building the loop once as a fixed frame keeps two questions cleanly apart: how capable the reasoning is, and how far the actions reach.

rich.cea2b64a5fbd.source: All of them perceive their environment through sensors and act on it through actuators. Because each action feeds the next observation, perceiving and acting fold into one continuous cycle, a perceive-reason-act loop, that lasts as long as the agent continues to interact. The agents you will build all adopt the same cycle and are set apart only by how much they can perceive and how far their actions reach.
rich.cea2b64a5fbd.value: 它们都会通过传感器感知环境，并通过执行器对环境采取行动。每次行动都会影响下一次观察，因此感知、推理和行动构成一个持续运转的循环。只要智能体仍在交互，这个感知、推理与行动循环就会持续。您将构建的所有智能体都采用同一循环，区别仅在于它们能感知多少信息，以及行动能够影响多大范围。

rich.cee21715c2e4.source: Validate the requested action. The choose_direction schema declares the allowed direction values. The model requests a direction, and the controller checks the tool name and arguments before moving. Inspect the request and response to distinguish the declared schema from the validation your code performs.

rich.cf35c227ca83.source: The controller records visited cells and a return path, filters out visited branches, and walks corridors. At junctions, the model reads the map and chooses the branch order through choose_direction. The controller manages depth-first exploration; it does not supply the model with a solved route.

text.3726bbc870f8.source:
You are navigating a maze.
You are called only at JUNCTIONS (2+ open directions).
You get an ASCII map that marks walls, explored cells, your position, and the goal.
Corridors are auto-walked, so your position can jump several cells between calls.
Choose ONE direction from "Allowed moves this turn" and call choose_direction().
Choose an unvisited neighbor when one is allowed; the controller records the search path.
When no unvisited neighbor remains, take the allowed backtrack along that path.
Prefer unvisited branches (-) over visited cells (·), and head toward G when you can see it.
Minimize reasoning efforts and make immediate moves.
text.3726bbc870f8.value: 您正在探索一个迷宫。仅在岔路口（有 2 个或更多可行方向）才会调用您。您会收到一幅标出墙壁、已探索格子、当前位置和目标的 ASCII 地图。走廊由控制器自动走过，因此两次调用之间，位置可能跨越多个格子。从“本轮允许的移动方向”中选择一个方向，然后调用 choose_direction()。如果允许，请选择尚未访问的相邻格子；控制器会记录搜索路径。没有尚未访问的相邻格子时，请沿该路径选择允许的返回方向。优先选择未访问的分支 (-)，而非已访问的格子 (·)；看到 G 时，请朝它前进。尽量减少推理，立即移动。
